question: Does the choice of code decide which nodes exist, or only when they are born?
protocol: EscrowGraph + BatchObjective(g).install(); repair() every 100 records; final repair(full=True)

rissanen.why: Kraft sum is one by construction: the constant log2(2.865064) is exactly the normaliser of the iterated log. The truncated sum below is a partial sum of a series with a heavy tail, so a value under one at 10^6 is the truncation and not slack.

simple_ceil.why: NOT a prefix code: every octave [2^j, 2^(j+1)-1] contributes exactly 1/4, so the Kraft sum diverges like (1/4) log2 x and already exceeds one at x = 8. It is a flat log code, not a universal integer code.

elias_gamma.why: Kraft-tight: the 2^j integers of length 2j+1 contribute 2^-(j+1) each octave, so the sum telescopes to one.

elias_delta.why: A prefix code; the sum stays below one at every truncation.

logstar_bare.why: NOT a prefix code: this is Rissanen's code with the normaliser removed, so its Kraft sum is the Rissanen constant 2.865064, an overspend of 1.5165 bits of licence per use.

shipped.note: the shipped code: Rissanen L_N, KT beta=1/2 everywhere, combinatorial support, naming = log2(inventory+1)

beta_col_laplace.note: Laplace (beta=1) on the membership column, the presence blocks, the presence predictive and the announcement code; this is the c=2 end of the paper's c in [1,2] family

beta_val_laplace.note: Laplace (beta=1) on the value blocks: escape Bernoulli, seen-value index, novelty column and repeat block

supp_bernoulli.note: factorised per-key Bernoulli scope code instead of L_N(|T|) + log2 C(A_n,|T|)

naming_tight.note: stage-three naming charged over the values this block has not seen plus one fresh slot, log2(inv-u+1); makes the three-stage escape Kraft-tight instead of the shipped sub-probability

combo_gamma.note: worst-case combination of valid changes, Elias gamma arm

combo_delta.note: worst-case combination of valid changes, Elias delta arm

intcode_simple_ceil.note: ceil(log2(x+1))+1 for L_N; NOT a prefix code, reported as a labelled diagnostic only

intcode_logstar_bare.note: bare log-star for L_N, Rissanen without the normaliser; NOT a prefix code, reported as a labelled diagnostic only

value_naming_term_finding.question: variant 4: can the inventory-size charge be switched off without breaking the Kraft identity?
value_naming_term_finding.answer: No. It is not a discretionary choice and no graph arm is run for it.
value_naming_term_finding.why: The stage-three charge is what identifies WHICH new value the escape stands for. With it, the predictive over the seen values, the unseen inventory values and one fresh slot sums to at most one. With naming = 0 the same escape mass is handed to every one of the inv - u + 1 unseen candidates at once, so the total predictive mass exceeds one and the code is not a code.
value_naming_term_finding.measured_on: the shipped Wikipedia run, over every value block at end of stream
value_naming_term_finding.already_recorded: codes.py ValueBlock.cost docstring and appendix.tex:154-156: dropping the naming stage minted 204 sibling nodes on the k=4 positive control.
value_naming_term_finding.valid_alternative_measured_instead: naming_tight, log2(inv - u + 1), which makes the same escape sum to exactly one and closes the sub-probability noted in GAPS Block 7(g).

reading: 11 encodings of the same three streams, 9 of them valid prefix codes and 2 kept only as labelled diagnostics, buy visibly different numbers of bits and agree on the graph wherever the graph is determined: the description length of the stream moves by 1092 bits (2.27 percent) on planted8, 2598 bits (5.65 percent) on shared_key, 2113 bits (7.97 percent) on wikipedia across the arms, while on planted8 every arm returns K = 8, adjusted Rand index 1.0000 between every pair of codes and against the planted truth, the same support keys, and not one record in 3000 changing node, with birth times moving by up to 217 records. On the streams where the shipped code does not itself recover the truth the codes disagree, and the comparison that decides whether that is a hidden knob is against the movement the same code already shows under a change of arrival order alone, a band it tracks on shared_key and exceeds on wikipedia: shared_key spans K = 2 to 3 against K = 2 to 3 for the shipped code over 20 arrival orders of the same records, and a worst pairwise adjusted Rand index of 0.6055 (0.6084 when only one choice is changed at a time) against 0.6068 across orders; wikipedia spans K = 2 to 6 against K = 3 to 6 for the shipped code over 20 arrival orders of the same records, and a worst pairwise adjusted Rand index of 0.5233 (0.5359 when only one choice is changed at a time) against 0.5804 across orders; the worst disagreement anywhere in the sweep is adjusted Rand index 0.5233 on wikipedia (intcode_elias_gamma vs combo_gamma), with 51.6 percent of records changing node. On shared_key and wikipedia the honest answer to the sharper question is that the code choice does change which nodes exist and not only when they are born: shared_key yields 4 different node identity sets across the 9 valid codes (for instance 0+1 against 1+2), but the same substitution happens under a change of arrival order alone, which produces 4 on shared_key and 5 on wikipedia identity sets over 20 permutations of the shipped code; the nodes that move are the marginal ones, since 11 of the 13 nodes the shipped code mints that hold at least five percent of their stream still have a counterpart under the least favourable valid variant. One item on the list turned out not to be a choice at all: the stage-three naming charge cannot be switched off, because without it the escape hands its whole mass to every unseen value at once and the block predictive sums to 85.8 instead of one, so it is reported here as a measured Kraft violation rather than as an ablation arm.
